verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies the blue-marked corridor as excessively wide and requests a design solution.
The client specifically requests narrowing the corridor by moving the adjacent room wall 10 cm.
The freelancer presents unresolved entrance-hall alternatives and warns that reallocating the area may place the three unit doors too close together.
The message concerns construction of partition walls and is better routed to REQ_PARTITION_WALL_LAYOUT than to the common-corridor layout Requirement.
